full_judgment: 4. Defendant Nos. 1-5 contested the suit by filing joint written statements denying the material allegations of the plaint and contended inter alia that the suit property originally belonged to Nagendra Kumar Guha and others. It has been contended that the suit property was rightly recorded in the name of the heirs of Prafullah Kumar Guha and others, who migrated to India following the Indo-Pakistan War in 1965 and permanently settled there, as result of which the suit property became a vested property by operation of law and it has been leased out to different persons as vested property. It has been further asserted by the contending defendants that the story of settlement of the suit land by Nagendra Kumar Guah in favour of Ranjit Kumar Ray is false and concocted. The suit land was rightly recorded in the S.A. Khatian in the names of the heirs of the original owner Negendra Kumar Guah and consequently the purchase of the suit land by the plaintiffs from Ranjit is a matter of no consequence.
